children: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has rejected Tata Sons' application to voluntarily surrender its certificate of registration as a non-banking financial company (NBFC), sources told CNBC-TV18.
With the application rejected, Tata Sons will have to comply with RBI regulations for upper-layer NBFCs, including the requirement to list on stock exchanges, the CNBC-TV18 report added.

The development comes after years of uncertainty over Tata Sons' regulatory status. The company had applied to the RBI in March 2024 to surrender its Core Investment Company (CIC) registration, after prepaying Rs21,813 crore of debt and turning net cash positive in FY24.

title: RBI rejects Tata Sons' application to surrender NBFC licence, reports CNBC-TV18
